verdict.rationale: Martin is a cloud personal-assistant agent, so headless or CI automation via an API, CLI, or SDK is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only conversational interfaces (phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, Slack) and built-in background tasks such as briefings and triage. No CLI, API, or headless mode is documented, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
